quotedTweet.text:
What is this fascination with peer review among docs?
What is peer review?
It means a couple of random scientists/physicians with or without domain expertise, and ranging in experience from just having completed PhD to a tenured Professor with decades of research experience (mostly those with lower experience), read your paper (many times superficially) and liked it in the final form (with or without errors).
